assertion.statement: For the actual E over K0=Q(sqrt2), the torsion subgroup is the displayed full group of order4 and the Mordell-Weil rank is1.
assertion.objects: The fixed curve E, its full rational two-torsion, descent quotient E(K0)/2E(K0), and good reductions at(17,s-6) and(23,s-5).
assertion.hypotheses: The separate two-isogeny calculation supplies quotient size8; the separately certified good reduction counts are20 and24; E is an elliptic curve over the number field K0.
assertion.quantifiers: For this fixed E/K0 and both stated good places.
assertion.parameter_range: The17-primary and23-primary torsion cases use the other good place; no claim of injection of residue-characteristic torsion at its own place.
assertion.normalizations: Mordell-Weil rank is the free Z-rank; it is not a Selmer corank or a generator-saturation statement.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The two residue characteristics are handled separately. Rank1 does not prove the displayed point is a generator; saturation still requires the height and finite enumeration arguments.
assertion.limit_order: Establish good reduction/counts and descent quotient, apply torsion injections and finite generation, then separately address saturation.
